field.name: beam_web_thickness

label.en: Beam web thickness t_wb (0 = not given)

field.doc: 🔩 Beam web thickness t_wb of an end plate joint for the beam web in tension F_t,wb,Rd = b_eff,t,wb t_wb f_y,wb / gamma_M0 (EN 1993-1-8 6.2.6.8); 0 = not given, the component is then not assessed and no value is assumed.
